summary: Tower on the ODF Southwest Oregon Unit Office grounds in Grants Pass, built in the 1930s per the register and removed in 1949; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: 40-foot tower with an L-6 cab (register); firelookout.com calls it a wooden observation tower
facts.status_note: Removed in 1949 per the register; no source describes what remains at the office today

events.note: Register says sometime in the 1930s, with no exact year; firelookout.com's header dates put the build in the 1940s

evidence.supports: 40-foot tower with L-6 cab built sometime in the 1930s at the ODF Southwest Oregon Unit Office
evidence.quote: Sometime in the 1930's a 40 foot tower with a L-6 cab was constructed at the ODF Southwest Oregon Unit Office.

evidence.supports: wooden observation tower at the ODF Southwest Oregon Unit Office
evidence.quote: This wooden observation tower was located at the ODF Southwest Oregon Unit Office.

evidence.supports: administered by the Oregon Department of Forestry
photo of the lookout from the 1940s, Rex Kamstra collection
evidence.quote: Grants Pass Lookout 1940's - courtesy of Rex Kamstra collection

corrections.why: The register's Built field reads 1930's, a decade, not a dated 1930 build

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says sometime in the 1930s. firelookout.com's header 'R.I.P. 1940s-1940s' places it in the 1940s. The record keeps the register's decade and the story reports both.
The register gives 1,157 ft (353 m) and firelookout.com gives 1000 ft. The record stores 352.7 m, the register's feet converted to metres.

notes_for_editor: Only two sources, which disagree on build decade and elevation. The firelookout.org index lists this site at 42.44456, -123.30929, a different point several kilometres from the register's coordinates (42.499609, -123.369304) that the record uses; the index lists only FFLOS US 1816, OR 539 for it, so the brief's shared-register note is not confirmed. No source says what remains or whether the ODF office grounds are open. Staffing is not stated anywhere we read. firelookout.com's 'wooden' is not in the register. One WebSearch found nothing specific to this tower; its hits were other southern Oregon lookouts, not used. The corrections block proposes a current built year of 1930, but the tower record's built field is null, so that correction is left for human review.
